set -euo pipefail; PRE=$(sha256sum buehne.html|awk '{print $1}'); T=$(mktemp -d /tmp/parallax-eye-seam-v2.XXXX); export T; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json, subprocess, os, cv2, numpy as np, shutil, time
from PIL import Image
root=Path('/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual'); t=Path(os.environ['T']); W,H=1536,1024
rolls=['-25','-20','-15','-10','-05','+00','+05','+10','+15','+20','+25']; anchors=json.load(open(root/'rig2/augen_anker_exakt.json'))['werte']; blink=Image.open(root/'augen_blink/blink_000.png').convert('RGBA'); sw,sh=blink.size
print('BLINK_SIZE',sw,sh); print('SUBJECT_SHA',os.popen('sha256sum buehne.html').read().strip())
def page(r,A):
 d=f'kopf_rgba_parallax/gier_+00_nick_+00_roll_{r}'; fs=[next((root/d).glob(f'slice_{i}_*.png')).name for i in range(4)]; off=anchors[str(int(r))]
 return f'''<!doctype html><meta charset=utf-8><style>html,body{{margin:0;width:{W}px;height:{H}px;overflow:hidden;background:#303030}}canvas{{display:block}}</style><canvas id=c width={W} height={H}></canvas><script>const c=document.getElementById('c'),x=c.getContext('2d');function I(u){{return new Promise((R,J)=>{{let i=new Image;i.onload=()=>R(i);i.onerror=J;i.src=u}})}};(async()=>{{let ss=await Promise.all({json.dumps(fs)}.map(n=>I('file://{root}/{d}/'+n)));let b=await I('file://{root}/augen_blink/blink_000.png');x.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';const co=[1,1/3,-1/3,-1];for(let i=0;i<4;i++)x.drawImage(ss[i],co[i]*{A},0);x.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';const pw={W}*.27,ph=pw*b.naturalHeight/b.naturalWidth,px={W}*.31,py={H}*.12,ox=px+pw*.7038,oy=py+ph*2.4132;x.save();x.translate({off['dx_px']},{off['dy_px']});x.translate(ox,oy);x.rotate(({int(r)})*Math.PI/180);x.translate(-ox,-oy);x.drawImage(b,px,py,pw,ph);x.restore();document.title='READY'}})();</script>'''
def capture(r,A):
 tag=('m'+r[1:] if r.startswith('-') else 'p'+r[1:]); at='a0' if A==0 else 'a025'; p=t/f'{tag}_{at}.html'; out=t/f'{tag}_{at}.png'; p.write_text(page(r,A))
 for attempt in range(3):
  prof=t/f'prof_{tag}_{at}_{attempt}'; shutil.rmtree(prof,ignore_errors=True); cmd=['/usr/bin/google-chrome','--headless=new','--no-sandbox','--allow-file-access-from-files','--hide-scrollbars','--disable-features=Translate',f'--user-data-dir={prof}',f'--window-size={W},{H}','--virtual-time-budget=3000',f'--screenshot={out}',f'file://{p}']; q=subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=20)
  ok=False
  if q.returncode==0 and out.exists() and out.stat().st_size>10000:
   try:
    with Image.open(out) as im: im.verify(); ok=True
   except Exception: ok=False
  print('CAPTURE',r,A,'attempt',attempt+1,'rc',q.returncode,'bytes',out.stat().st_size if out.exists() else 0,'ok',ok)
  shutil.rmtree(prof,ignore_errors=True)
  if ok:return out
  time.sleep(.2)
 raise RuntimeError(f'capture failed {r} {A}')
shots={};
for r in rolls:
 shots[(r,0)]=capture(r,0); shots[(r,.25)]=capture(r,.25)
pw=W*.27;ph=pw*sh/sw;px=W*.31;py=H*.12;small=cv2.resize(np.array(blink)[:,:,3],(round(pw),round(ph)),interpolation=cv2.INTER_LINEAR);base=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8);ix,iy=round(px),round(py);hh,ww=small.shape;base[iy:iy+hh,ix:ix+ww]=small[:min(hh,H-iy),:min(ww,W-ix)]
rows=[]
for r in rolls:
 a=cv2.imread(str(shots[(r,0)]));v=cv2.imread(str(shots[(r,.25)]));assert a is not None and v is not None and a.shape==v.shape
 off=anchors[str(int(r))];ox=px+pw*.7038;oy=py+ph*2.4132;M=cv2.getRotationMatrix2D((ox,oy),-int(r),1.0);M[0,2]+=off['dx_px'];M[1,2]+=off['dy_px'];m=cv2.warpAffine(base,M,(W,H),flags=cv2.INTER_LINEAR,borderMode=cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT,borderValue=0);sup=m>=16;dil=cv2.dilate(sup.astype(np.uint8),np.ones((13,13),np.uint8)).astype(bool);ero=cv2.erode(sup.astype(np.uint8),np.ones((9,9),np.uint8)).astype(bool);ring=dil&~ero;outer=dil&~sup
 g0=cv2.cvtColor(a,cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY).astype(np.float32);g1=cv2.cvtColor(v,cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY).astype(np.float32);e0=np.hypot(cv2.Sobel(g0,cv2.CV_32F,1,0,ksize=3),cv2.Sobel(g0,cv2.CV_32F,0,1,ksize=3));e1=np.hypot(cv2.Sobel(g1,cv2.CV_32F,1,0,ksize=3),cv2.Sobel(g1,cv2.CV_32F,0,1,ksize=3));d=np.abs(v.astype(np.int16)-a.astype(np.int16)).mean(axis=2)
 mn=lambda z,s:float(z[s].mean()) if s.any() else 0;q=lambda z,s,p:float(np.quantile(z[s],p)) if s.any() else 0
 rec={'roll':r,'ring_diff_mae':mn(d,ring),'ring_diff_p99':q(d,ring,.99),'outer_diff_mae':mn(d,outer),'core_diff_mae':mn(d,sup),'ring_edge_ratio':mn(e1,ring)/(mn(e0,ring)+1e-6),'ring_edge_p99_ratio':q(e1,ring,.99)/(q(e0,ring,.99)+1e-6)};rows.append(rec);print('ROLL',r,'ring_mae',f"{rec['ring_diff_mae']:.4f}",'ring_p99',f"{rec['ring_diff_p99']:.4f}",'outer_mae',f"{rec['outer_diff_mae']:.4f}",'core_mae',f"{rec['core_diff_mae']:.4f}",'edge_ratio',f"{rec['ring_edge_ratio']:.5f}",'edge_p99_ratio',f"{rec['ring_edge_p99_ratio']:.5f}")
print('WORST',json.dumps({'max_ring_mae':max(x['ring_diff_mae'] for x in rows),'max_ring_p99':max(x['ring_diff_p99'] for x in rows),'max_outer_mae':max(x['outer_diff_mae'] for x in rows),'max_core_mae':max(x['core_diff_mae'] for x in rows),'ring_edge_ratio_range':[min(x['ring_edge_ratio'] for x in rows),max(x['ring_edge_ratio'] for x in rows)],'ring_edge_p99_ratio_range':[min(x['ring_edge_p99_ratio'] for x in rows),max(x['ring_edge_p99_ratio'] for x in rows)]},sort_keys=True))
